Before any timeline or cost can be estimated, the operator must obtain written confirmation from San Francisco Planning whether a Conditional Use Authorization pathway exists or whether the concept must be modified to qualify as non-formula retail. If Planning confirms a CUA pathway is available, the timeline would include 120–300 days for a Conditional Use Authorization hearing (including pre-application, environmental review, 300-foot notice, and hearing scheduling) at a cost of approximately $3,100–$15,000 in CUA fees, plus building permit plan review (14–120 days, $800–$15,000), health plan check and permit (35–105 days combined, $1,298–$3,500), and ancillary permits.
